# v1.1.0-dev.119: The full-audit release

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.118`.

A whole-repo audit with adversarially verified findings: 61 confirmed
fixes across the app, the persistence layer and the docs. The ones you
can see:

## Every load answers the app window again

Loading a profile with docked windows from the tray, a hotkey, the
command line, a `wlm://` link or auto-activation silently skipped the
app window's status refresh, and applying a remap reported a failure
after the windows had already moved. Same root cause: a live window
handle that cannot cross the process boundary was riding along in the
reply. All three replies now strip it, the same fix the Load button
got in dev.109-era code.

## Hold honors the blacklist everywhere

Two Hold paths had bypassed the capture blacklist: dragging a window
you had excluded was still recorded into the held profile if the rule
spelled the app name the way Task Manager does (`name.exe`), and an
excluded app with a leftover saved entry could get snapped on launch.
Both paths now use the same matcher every capture uses.

## An Update keeps what a docked window owns

Pressing Update on a profile with anything docked dropped that window's
Hold rollback trail. Worse, if the shared container library already
held a container your profile also knew about, the start-up migration
moved your docked windows out of the profile and threw them away
instead of merging them in. Both carry what they should now.

## The keyboard walks only what you can see

In List view, j/k could park the cursor on a window docked into a
container, which has no row, and Enter or x would then edit or delete
an invisible selection. The cursor now moves through exactly the rows
the list renders.

## And the rest

A container minimizing no longer leaves its docked-windows modal
floating over the desktop, and a group raise no longer buries it. The
drag guide is the right size on a maximized container. The display
editor's status line names the profile instead of "null". A cancelled
reorder drag no longer wedges the editor. Sharing a container across
profiles keeps both quick checkbox ticks. The relay would have
redacted usernames pasted into report titles. Failing hardware probes
read "unknown" instead of a confident "not installed". The docs
describe the app as it is, through this release.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
